title: Tangential derivatives are well defined: fderivWithin agrees with any derivative within M on span(tangentSpace M x)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, E a real normed space, M ⊆ ℝ^P, f : ℝ^P → E, f' : ℝ^P →L[ℝ] E and x ∈ ℝ^P. If f has derivative f' within M at x (HasFDerivWithinAt f f' M x), then fderivWithin ℝ f M x v = f' v for every v in the linear span of tangentSpace M x (the velocities γ'(0) of curves γ, C¹ on (−1,1), with γ((−1,1)) ⊆ M and γ(0) = x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → E) (f' : Euclid P →L[ℝ] E) (x : Euclid P), HasFDerivWithinAt f f' M x → ∀ v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x), fderivWithin ℝ f M x v = f' v
